metadata.description: ISO 27001 control mappings for DORA requirements

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.
controls.relevance: High - DORA requires comprehensive ICT risk management policies

controls.title: Review of the policies for information security
controls.description: The policies for information security shall be reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur.
controls.relevance: High - Regular review aligns with DORA's continuous monitoring requirements

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: All information security responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.
controls.relevance: High - DORA requires clear accountability for ICT risk management

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to all personnel who need them.
controls.relevance: Medium - Supports DORA's requirement for documented processes

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated, and appropriate measures taken to address the associated risk.
controls.relevance: High - Critical for DORA's vulnerability management requirements

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: Information security incident management responsibilities and procedures shall be established to ensure a quick, effective and orderly response to information security incidents.
controls.relevance: High - Directly aligns with DORA's incident management requirements

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from analyzing and resolving information security incidents shall be used to reduce the likelihood or impact of future incidents.
controls.relevance: High - Supports DORA's continuous improvement requirements

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.description: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of information that can serve as evidence.
controls.relevance: High - Critical for DORA's incident reporting and evidence requirements

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.
controls.relevance: High - Required for DORA's regulatory reporting

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained in a timely fashion.
controls.relevance: High - Supports vulnerability testing requirements

controls.title: Secure development policy
controls.description: Rules for the development of software and systems shall be established and applied to developments within the organization.
controls.relevance: Medium - Supports secure development practices

controls.title: System security testing
controls.description: Security testing shall cover security functionality, technical vulnerability testing and penetration testing.
controls.relevance: High - Directly aligns with DORA's resilience testing requirements

controls.title: Identification of applicable legislation and contractual requirements
controls.description: All relevant legislative, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements and the organization's approach to meet these requirements shall be explicitly identified, documented and kept up to date.
controls.relevance: High - Ensures compliance with DORA testing requirements

controls.title: Information security policy for supplier relationships
controls.description: Information security requirements for mitigating the risks associated with supplier's access to the organization's assets shall be agreed with the supplier and documented.
controls.relevance: High - Directly addresses DORA's third-party risk management

controls.title: Addressing security within supplier agreements
controls.description: All relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier that may access, process, store, communicate, or provide IT infrastructure components for, the organization's information.
controls.relevance: High - Critical for DORA's third-party agreements

controls.title: Information and communication technology supply chain
controls.description: Agreements with suppliers shall include requirements to address the information security risks associated with information and communications technology services and product supply chain.
controls.relevance: High - Essential for DORA's ICT third-party risk management

controls.title: Monitoring and review of supplier services
controls.description: Organizations shall regularly monitor, review and audit supplier service delivery.
controls.relevance: High - Supports DORA's ongoing monitoring of third parties

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.
controls.relevance: High - Required for DORA's information sharing arrangements

controls.title: Information transfer policies and procedures
controls.description: Information transfer policies, procedures and controls shall be in place to protect the transfer of information through the use of all types of communication facilities.
controls.relevance: High - Supports secure information sharing

controls.title: Agreements on information transfer
controls.description: Agreements shall address the secure transfer of business information between the organization and external parties.
controls.relevance: High - Required for DORA's information sharing agreements
